transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Can you first tell me when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes — you can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to keep it light at first. Avoid heavy work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to ask when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thanks. I'm also feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But if it’s severe, or if your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that was all I wanted to know. Thanks for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you very much!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses" in turn 6. However, the agent did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice` at any point in the conversation. The agent was interrupted after partially delivering the first point and did not return to the topic of light sensitivity.
